name: Handwerk
intro: Fürs Handwerk: Logo drauf (gern auch ein zweites), Gewerk wählen, Namensliste mit Größen hochladen – Otto zeichnet euer Werkzeug dazu.
headline: Das Motiv für euren Betrieb
text: Firmenlogo hochladen – auf Wunsch ein zweites dazu (Innung, Partner, Hersteller) –, Gewerk auswählen, fertig: Otto zeichnet ein kraftvolles Motiv aus den Werkzeugen und Szenen eures Handwerks und setzt eure Logos unverändert oben ein. Namensliste der Mitarbeiter mit Größen einfach hochladen (Excel oder CSV): Jeder bekommt sein eigenes Design mit seinem Namen, auf Wunsch stehen hinten alle Namen – und die Liste ist gleichzeitig eure Bestellliste. So einfach war Firmenkleidung noch nie.
variations:
two main tools of the trade crossed BEHIND the central motif, their handles reaching out past it on both sides
the trade's own material packed tightly around the central motif like a worn hand-made frame, touching its edge on every side, tools wedged into it
the trade at work as a bold silhouette without faces, standing to one side and looking towards the central motif
the trade's material stacked into a solid base that the central motif rests on, tools leaning against it
the trade's tools fanned out behind the central motif like rays, longest at the top
the trade's key machine or vehicle behind the central motif, only its upper half visible, the rest hidden by it
sparks, chips or dust bursting out from behind the central motif, tools at the edges where they were struck
two upright elements of the trade left and right of the central motif like a gateway, a beam or ribbon across the top
the trade's tools hanging on a wall of the trade's material, one tool lifted out and held up in front of them
a wide band of the trade's work, running behind the central motif and out to both edges
the helmet or cap of the trade sitting on top of the central motif, tools crossed underneath it

upload.label: Firmenlogo
upload.hint: PNG mit freigestelltem Hintergrund wird am schönsten. Wird unverändert eingesetzt. Ein zweites Logo (Innung, Partner, Hersteller) kommt daneben.
upload.label2: Zweites Logo (Co-Branding, z. B. Innung oder Partner)

prompt:
Bold craftsman's work-shirt print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

Do not invent or draw any company logo, emblem or badge - the company's own logo is added afterwards as a real file and the design is built around it. Leave no empty area, plate or frame for it: the artwork is complete in itself.
Strong lettering reads exactly "{firma}".
[[A line underneath reads exactly "{ort}".]]
[[A curved line or banner near the bottom reads exactly "{spruch}".]]

The trade is {gewerk}[[ - more precisely: {gewerk_frei}]]. The central motif is a striking, proud illustration of exactly this trade: its typical tools, machines, materials and a characteristic scene (roof, slates and slate hammer for roofers; beam, axe and roof truss for carpenters; brush, roller and paint for painters; pipe wrench, pipes and flame for plumbers; cable, plug and lightning for electricians; trowel, bricks and level for masons; and so on). Show the tools of no other trade. No real brand names or logos on the tools, no recognizable people, no faces.
The central motif and the arrangement follow the variation given below - a different picture every time.

Style: rugged workwear print, heavy outlines, industrial palette of one strong signal colour (safety orange or yellow) plus steel grey, cream and black, light distressed texture, no gradients, no photorealism.
